description: Counts exactly what language models are bad at counting: characters (as humans see them), words, lines, sentences, paragraphs, UTF-8 bytes, and occurrences of a letter or substring (e.g. how many "r" in "strawberry"). Use it to check length limits (tweets, SMS, meta descriptions, form fields) before submitting text.

count.description: Optional letter, word or substring to count occurrences of

overlapping.description: For `count`: count overlapping matches ("aa" in "aaa" = 2). Default false.

name: text_stats
title: Count characters, words and lines
